title: When to Adapt: Conditional Memory Adapters for Retention-Preserving Domain Specialization
abstract: arXiv:2608.29327v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large language models deployed in specialized domains must improve in-domain performance without sacrificing general capabilities. Existing parameter-efficient fine-tuning methods are typically always on: their learned perturbations are applied to every input, which can degrade out-of-domain (OOD) performance. We propose Engram Adapter, a framework that repurposes pretraining-time conditional memory as a post-hoc adapter for frozen LLMs. It uses multi-channel matching over local n-gram patterns with explicit occupancy tracking as a lightweight selectivity prior, making residual injection more likely on in-domain inputs while a learned scalar gate suppresses incoherent OOD retrievals. We evaluate on Qwen3-4B and Qwen3-8B with AG-News and MedMCQA as adaptation tasks and OOD benchmarks spanning reasoning, translation, code generation, and legal reasoning. Engram Adapter improves in-domain accuracy while preserving 99.4%--100.1% of average O

translated_title: 何时适配：面向保持通用能力领域专业化的条件记忆适配器
translated_abstract: 部署在专业领域的大型语言模型必须在提升领域内性能的同时不牺牲通用能力。现有的参数高效微调方法通常是“始终开启”的：其学习到的扰动被应用于每一个输入，这可能会降低域外（OOD）性能。我们提出了Engram Adapter，一个将预训练阶段的条件记忆重新用作冻结大语言模型事后适配器的框架。它通过对局部n-gram模式进行多通道匹配并结合显式占用跟踪，作为轻量级的选择性先验，使残差注入更有可能发生在领域内输入上，同时由一个可学习的标量门抑制不连贯的域外检索。我们在Qwen3-4B和Qwen3-8B上进行评估，使用AG-News和MedMCQA作为适配任务，域外基准涵盖推理、翻译、代码生成和法律推理。Engram Adapter在提升领域内准确率的同时，保留了99.4%–100.1%的平均域外性能。
tldr: 提出Engram Adapter框架，将预训练条件记忆转化为可选择性激活的事后适配器，通过n-gram多通道匹配与标量门控判断“何时适配”，在提升领域内性能的同时几乎完整保留模型的通用能力。
en_tdlr: Proposes Engram Adapter, which repurposes pretraining conditional memory as a selectively activated post-hoc adapter for frozen LLMs, using n-gram matching and a learned gate to decide when to adapt, thereby improving in-domain performance while preserving general out-of-domain capabilities.
